selections.rationale: Grounded quantitative-risk work with disciplined technical detail; distinct derivatives and insurance-capital focus preserves outcome diversity, though role targeting is indirect.
Strongly grounded regulated-institution work combining traceable scenarios, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence without unsupported AI or partnership claims.
